start.text: Chai, boss? Twenty rupees. Fresh — kettle just now boiled. You are coming from outside, no? I can hear it in the hello.

choices.text: Where do I get a bus to Whitefield?

paid.text: Scan, scan… ting! See, money gone already — Bengaluru welcomes you. Whitefield, you said? Don't go with those taxi fellows outside. Vayu Vajra bus, gate 4, two-fifty. Air-conditioned also.

directions.text: Vayu Vajra, right outside gate 4. Blue bus, says KIA-8. Two hundred fifty rupees, UPI works. Taxi fellows will say eighteen hundred — walk past them like you know the place.

decline.text: Okay okay. Bus is outside gate 4 anyway — Vayu Vajra, two-fifty. Next time, chai.

farewell.text: Go, go. The bus doesn't wait and the city doesn't either.
